CANONICAL_NAME.value: pid-autotune (Hirschmann) -- Astrom-Hagglund relay-feedback autotuner with Ziegler-Nichols / Tyreus-Luyben / Pessen rules, on a simulated brewing kettle

VERSION.value: github.com/hirschmann/pid-autotune master as of 2026-09-13 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: Astrom & Hagglund's relay auto-tuning (Automatica 1984): put the loop under a relay, measure the induced limit cycle's amplitude and period (ultimate gain and period), then compute PID gains by a tuning rule -- the mechanism inside industrial PID controllers' 'autotune' buttons. This implementation (2016-) drives a first-order thermal kettle model (volume, heater power, ambient loss) and prints the gains each rule yields; used by home-brewing controllers (CraftBeerPi lineage).

value.built_to: let a controller find its own gains from the plant it is attached to, by provoking a controlled oscillation and measuring it

cut.note: Astrom-Hagglund relay tuning in one class: the output is switched between initial +step and initial -step whenever the input crosses the setpoint by more than a noise band, which drives the loop into a limit cycle; peaks are detected as local extrema over a look-back window; when five peaks exist and the last four peak-to-peak amplitudes agree within 5 percent the cycle is accepted; the ultimate gain is 4 d / (pi a) from the relay step d and the cycle amplitude a, the ultimate period from the peak timestamps, and PID gains come from a table of divisor triples per named tuning rule

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: run() (100-125): STATE_RELAY_STEP_UP / DOWN; switch on input > setpoint + noiseband or < setpoint - noiseband; output = initial +/- outputstep clamped to [out_min, out_max]; sampletime gate
organs.mechanism: at each sample (no more often than the sample time) the state flips from stepping up to stepping down when the input exceeds the setpoint by the noise band, and back when it falls below by the noise band; the output is the initial output plus or minus the step accordingly, clamped to the limits; the hysteresis band prevents chattering on noise
assumptions: a process under relay feedback oscillates at the frequency where its phase lag is 180 degrees (the describing-function argument); the oscillation amplitude and period identify the ultimate gain and period without an open-loop step test
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the tuning experiment stays closed-loop and bounded (the process never runs away); the mechanism inside industrial 'autotune' buttons
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: a process with no 180-degree crossing (first order without delay) never cycles; the noise band trades false switching against amplitude bias

organs.human_name: run() (126-165): is_max / is_min over the deque of lookback/sampletime inputs; inflection when the extremum type flips; peaks and peak_timestamps deques of 5; induced_amplitude = mean of the last four peak-to-peak differences; amplitude_dev against half the max-min range; PEAK_AMPLITUDE_TOLERANCE 0.05; STATE_FAILED at 20 peaks
organs.mechanism: the last look-back seconds of input are kept; a sample that is the maximum (or minimum) of the window marks a peak type; a change of type is an inflection and the sample is recorded as a peak with its time; once more than four peaks exist, the induced amplitude is the average of the four most recent peak-to-peak swings and is compared with half the total range; if they agree within 5 percent the limit cycle is declared steady (SUCCEEDED); if twenty peaks pass without agreement the tuning FAILS and the output is zeroed
organs.output: a, the peak times, a verdict
assumptions: a steady limit cycle has equal successive amplitudes; five peaks (two full periods) are enough to judge; a bounded number of peaks bounds the experiment
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the cycle is measured only once it is steady, and the experiment cannot run forever
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the look-back window must exceed half a period or every sample is an extremum; the 5 percent tolerance and the 20-peak cap are constants

organs.human_name: Ku = 4 outputstep / (induced_amplitude pi); Pu = mean of two peak-to-peak periods from timestamps[1..4]; get_pid_parameters: kp = Ku / d0, ki = kp / (Pu / d1), kd = kp * (Pu / d2); _tuning_rules: ziegler-nichols [34, 40, 160], tyreus-luyben, ciancone-marlin, pessen-integral, some-overshoot, no-overshoot, brewing [2.5, 6, 380]
organs.mechanism: the describing function of a relay of amplitude d driving a cycle of amplitude a gives the ultimate gain 4 d / (pi a); the ultimate period is the average of two full periods measured between alternate peaks; a tuning rule is three divisors applied to Ku and Pu (Ziegler-Nichols' 0.6 Ku, Pu/2, Pu/8 appear here scaled by 100 as 34, 40, 160 for the author's percent-scaled controller), and six other rules are the same shape with other constants
organs.input: outputstep, a, the timestamps, a rule name
assumptions: the process is well enough described by its ultimate point for a rule of thumb; different rules trade overshoot against speed
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: one experiment, seven tunings; the divisor table is the whole of the tuning knowledge
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the constants are scaled to the author's percent-output kettle controller and are not the textbook values as written
organs.human_prior: Ziegler & Nichols 1942; Tyreus & Luyben 1992; the relay identification of Astrom & Hagglund 1984

pressures.condition: an organism must find PID gains for a process it does not know, by manipulating the output and watching the input; the process must stay within bounds throughout; noise is present; some processes do not oscillate under relay; the score is the closed-loop performance of the resulting gains and the experiment's duration
pressures.resource_or_constraint: a relay step; a peak cap
pressures.failure_condition: an unbounded excursion during identification, gains from an unsteady cycle, or an experiment that never ends
pressures.world_punishes: open-loop step tests on integrating processes; accepting the first two peaks; no cap
pressures.world_rewards: relay feedback with hysteresis, steadiness acceptance, a peak cap, a rule table
pressures.observable_consequence: on the kettle simulation with noise: the identified Ku and Pu vs the analytic values, the experiment length, and the step response of the tuned loop for each rule; a non-oscillating process must reach FAILED
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given the kettle's parameters must compute Ku and Pu exactly; the tuner with the steadiness check removed must return biased gains on the noisy kettle; the tuner on a first-order process without delay must FAIL within 20 peaks: the world must show all three
